name: Whisparr Sync
description: Connects Cove to the Whisparr instance you configure, calling outward to it over the network and authenticating with the API key you supply. Its settings tab tests a connection, reports which Whisparr generation answered, keeps each generation's connection separately, and registers Cove's import callback in the instance. A delivery through that callback is matched against your Cove library folders and brought into your library. A Whisparr control on studio and performer pages, and in those lists' selection bars, monitors and unmonitors an entity on the connected instance. From that same control it also registers the scenes Cove holds that the instance's catalogue does not, and asks the instance to link files Cove already holds into place; neither downloads anything. One separately named action, Search all monitored, does ask the instance to search for what a monitored entity wants and to download what it finds. It acts on one studio or one performer at a time and is not offered for a selection. It exposes inbound API endpoints under /api/extensions/com.alextomas955.whisparrsync. All but one are gated on a Cove permission. The single exception is the import callback at /api/extensions/com.alextomas955.whisparrsync/callback, which answers anonymously because the caller is Whisparr rather than a Cove user; it is authenticated instead by a secret this extension mints and stores server-side, and a request that does not present it is refused. Only actions you start can cause Whisparr to download anything. Your Whisparr API key is held server-side in Cove and is never sent to the browser. Runs no scraper and no downloader code of its own.
author: alextomas955
